summary: Resolves two scene node handles for the steward light/glow setup: evaluates scene node property index 0 for node identifier a2 and stores the handle at this+4 (line node), then for node identifier a3 storing at this+8 (glow node). If a resolved handle is zero, a scene-path split loop with an error code is attempted and, when it succeeds, a "could not find line/glow" message is written to the debug log buffer dword_8AD25C. Returns the glow node handle (zero when not found).

operations.description: Evaluate scene node property index 0 of the line node identifier a2 via EvaluateSceneNodeProperty and store the resulting handle in this+4.

When the line node handle is zero and StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_3, 642) succeeds, write the 'could not find line' message (aCouldNotFindLi) to the debug log via DebugLogWrite using buffer dword_8AD25C.
Evaluate scene node property index 0 of the glow node identifier a3 via EvaluateSceneNodeProperty and store the resulting handle in this+8.

When the glow node handle is zero, run StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_3, 645); on success write the 'could not find glow' message (aCouldNotFindGl) to the debug log via DebugLogWrite using buffer dword_8AD25C and return that result.
Return the glow node handle (zero when the glow node could not be resolved).
